mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.stated_objective_pain_point: Many CubeSat teams are first-time developers with small budgets and limited systems-engineering capacity. The project aims to demonstrate MBSE/OOSEM and provide a reusable CubeSat Reference Model for mission-specific models and concept lifecycle studies.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_level_of_abstraction: System boundary is a CubeSat mission including space and ground systems. Abstraction is primarily logical architecture, stakeholder/MOE structure, operations phases, subsystem-level power/weight parameters, and concept trade-study behavior; mission teams create the physical architecture.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.minimal_or_excluded_modeling: Detailed physical architecture, component implementation, detailed EPS behavior, executable model files, concrete trace matrices, and validation results are not included. Example mission-specific model validation is future work.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.required_prior_behavioral_domain_knowled: Not explicitly characterized. Users must supply mission-specific stakeholders, objectives, model elements, parameters, and simulation interfaces; the reference model reduces start-up burden by supplying logical elements, nomenclature, and workflow.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.handling_limited_behavioral_knowledge: The model supplies reusable logical building blocks and lifecycle-phase subsets, so teams can gradually populate mission-specific stakeholders, measures, parameters, and behavior diagrams rather than starting from a blank model.

RQ1: Strong system-level evidence for a general CubeSat SysML/OOSEM reference model with logical architecture, stakeholders, lifecycle stages, operations phases, and reusable subsystem building blocks.
Limited EPS-specific generality: Power subsystem and power/weight parametrics are present, but detailed EPS behavior/requirements are not developed.
RQ2: Claimed outcomes include reuse, reduced systems-engineering burden, checklist completeness, uniformity/consistency, single-source repository, and concept trade decision support.
Outcome evidence is weak: no measured reliability/reproducibility/integrability effects, no baseline, and no current quantitative results.
RQ3: Pre-physical verification appears only as conceptual trade-study requirements verification and simulation-in-the-loop parameter exchange with STK.
No EPS-specific verification procedure, test cases/procedures, verification matrix, SIL/HIL, or automated checks are provided.
